remarks: Welcome to 31 High Street #4-2B - a beautifully updated one-bedroom, one-bath condo perfectly situated in the heart of Norwalk! This bright and inviting unit offers a stylish, well-maintained interior with modern finishes throughout. The kitchen features sleek white cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, and granite countertops. The spacious bedroom enjoys direct balcony access- ideal for morning coffee or unwinding at day's end. Enjoy the comfort of central air, designated parking, and additional designated storage space, all within a professionally managed complex. Located just moments from vibrant SoNo, The Maritime Aquarium, Calf Pasture Beach, and a variety of restaurants, cafes, and shopping destinations, you'll love the convenience of being close to everything Norwalk has to offer. Easy access to I-95 and the train station makes commuting a breeze, whether heading to Stamford or New York City. Move-in ready and low-maintenance, this condo offers the perfect blend of modern living and prime location - a great opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors alike.
